register.matter: Alder Quay Settlement — first decision paper at 16:00 BST, 12 June 2026
register.origin_and_reporter: PD-6834-R, dated 21 October 2022, reported by Tess Arnay in m4v7; June appointments-book position reported by Maren Dovell in j8f2. Both are in the closed file.
register.authority: Nell Carvane and Tobin Rell exercise discretion over income and capital jointly. An object has no entitlement before an appointment in that object's favour. Existing objects continue unless separately removed by deed. England and Wales law applies.
register.disposition: No Alder Quay decision authorising a payment, amount or payee is evidenced by cut-off; there is no decision reference to enter. Do not minute a new decision as already taken.
register.competing_passages_and_reason: j8f2 expressly authorises no payment. Ione's request in b9k4 is not a joint appointment. EX-K4 in t3w6 is office expenditure, not an Alder Quay decision. SD-Q7M2 was delivered against a different parent. None changes this list.

register.matter: Alder Quay Settlement — possible addition, not a distribution
register.origin_and_reporter: Clause 6 of the 2022 deed, certified in m4v7 and held by cut-off.
register.disposition: The serving trustees may unanimously add a named living individual other than the settlor or a serving trustee, without the settlor's consent, by jointly delivering a deed. If using common custody, they may state PD-6834-R jointly against the designation's unique reference. The custodian memorialises delivery.
register.competing_passages_and_reason: The plea to consider Sella Quist in b9k4 does not exercise that power. The common trustees and similar addition clauses do not make a Flint Orchard delivery an Alder Quay delivery.

register.matter: Flint Orchard Settlement — second decision paper at 16:00 BST, 12 June 2026
register.origin_and_reporter: PD-6894-R of 21 October 2022 (Bram Lerrit, x2c9); SD-Q7M2 and its 26 March 2026 handover (Alys Morcant, h6q3; Gideon Sarn, r5n8); current book report (Maren Dovell, j8f2). All held by cut-off.
register.authority: Nell Carvane and Tobin Rell act together over income and capital. They may apply funds directly for an Object's benefit. Eligibility alone confers no right to payment. All serving trustees acting together may add by jointly delivered deed a named living individual other than the settlor or a serving trustee; no other consent is required. Existing Objects continue unless separately removed by deed. England and Wales law applies.
register.disposition: No Flint Orchard decision authorising a payment, amount or payee is evidenced by cut-off; there is no decision reference to enter. In particular, Rhea may be considered but no property was appointed to her by SD-Q7M2.
register.competing_passages_and_reason: The original list in x2c9 predates the addition; it does not negate Rhea's later eligibility. Conversely h6q3 makes an addition only, not a removal or a payment. Neither the direct-benefit power nor the letter nor the office reimbursement is a recorded exercise of distribution discretion.

register.matter: Claim that SD-Q7M2 added Rhea Marden to Alder Quay, or to both settlements
register.origin_and_reporter: Trustees' reference confirmation at 11:30 GMT on 26 March 2026, recorded at handover by Gideon Sarn (r5n8); parent identities certified by Tess Arnay and Bram Lerrit (m4v7, x2c9). All three extracts were held by cut-off.
register.competing_passages_and_reason: Read alone, h6q3 leaves the parent open: both deeds allow this form and both have the same trustees. But r5n8 reports one original and an unqualified PD-6894-R against SD-Q7M2. Flint Orchard is PD-6894-R; Alder Quay is PD-6834-R. No character in the actual pair is marked unreadable.
register.disposition: Withhold Rhea Marden beneficiary_of Alder Quay Settlement. The specific rival delivery claim conflicts with the affirmative handover evidence; the file need not prove that no other instrument could ever exist. Neither a trust-name omission, a digit guessed from a similar reference, nor an imagined second counterpart is a rival proof route.

register.matter: Claims that signature alone effected the addition, that the register itself designated Rhea, or that the designation awarded money or displaced an object
register.origin_and_reporter: Trustees' instrument transcribed before handover by Alys Morcant (h6q3); clause 8 certified by Bram Lerrit (x2c9); handover recorded by Gideon Sarn (r5n8). All in the closed file.
register.competing_passages_and_reason: h6q3: “This instrument makes that addition only. It does not remove any Object, appoint any property, direct any payment or alter any other provision of the parent deed.” Alys expressly does not attest delivery. x2c9: “The register records the delivery, not the designation.”
register.disposition: Use the trustees' joint delivery on 26 March as the effective event. The transcript proves the signed terms; the later certified register extract is evidence of what happened at handover, not a second instrument or a June effective date.
